16. If n(A∪B∪C) = 100, n(A) = 4x, n(B) = 6x, n(C) = 5x, n(A∩B) = 20, n(B∩C) = 15, n(A∩C) = 25 and n(A∩B∩C) = 10, then the value of x is
(1) 10 (2) 15 (3) 25 (4) 30
steps: Divide by 15 to obtain x = 10, which is option (1).
